typical_price_momentum.name: Typical Price Momentum
typical_price_momentum.comment: Z-scored spread between fast EMA and slow EMA of typical_price

weighted_close_bias.name: Weighted Close Bias
weighted_close_bias.comment: weighted_close EMA(n) / weighted_close EMA(2n) - 1 with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

rolling_vwap.name: Rolling VWAP
rolling_vwap.comment: rolling_vwap = rolling sum(typical_price * Volume) / rolling sum(Volume)

vwap_bias.name: VWAP Bias
vwap_bias.comment: rolling_vwap / rolling mean(rolling_vwap, n) - 1 with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

vwap_range_position.name: VWAP Range Position
vwap_range_position.comment: Rolling VWAP normalized within its rolling min/max range

avgprice.name: AvgPrice
avgprice.comment: Rolling VWAP normalized within its rolling range

Vwapbias.name: Vwapbias
Vwapbias.comment: Rolling VWAP divided by its moving average minus 1

vwap_signal.name: VwapSignal
vwap_signal.comment: Typical price relative to rolling VWAP minus 1

Vwapbias.name: Vwapbias
Vwapbias.comment: Rolling VWAP divided by its moving average minus 1

open_range_high_2.name: Open Range High 2
open_range_high_2.comment: High of the first two bars in each trading day

open_range_low_2.name: Open Range Low 2
open_range_low_2.comment: Low of the first two bars in each trading day

session_open.name: Session Open
session_open.comment: First Open value of each trading day

session_high_shift1.name: Prior Session Running High
session_high_shift1.comment: Running session High shifted one bar within the trading day

session_low_shift1.name: Prior Session Running Low
session_low_shift1.comment: Running session Low shifted one bar within the trading day

close_vs_session_range.name: Close vs Session Range
close_vs_session_range.comment: Close normalized within prior shifted session high-low range

session_range_pct.name: Session Range Percent
session_range_pct.comment: Running session high-low range divided by session_open, percent

session_body_pct.name: Session Body Percent
session_body_pct.comment: Close minus session_open divided by session_open, percent

session_body_rate.name: Session Body Rate
session_body_rate.comment: Close minus session_open divided by previous trading day range

session_mom_y.name: Session Momentum Y
session_mom_y.comment: Close percent change versus previous trading day close

mom_y.name: Momentum Y
mom_y.comment: Close percent change versus previous day 14:45 close fallback

body_rate_first_close.name: Body Rate First Close
body_rate_first_close.comment: Close minus first_close_0915 divided by pre-13:45 high minus pre-13:55 low

opening_gap_pct.name: Opening Gap Percent
opening_gap_pct.comment: First 09:15 close versus previous day 14:45 close fallback, percent

session_vwap.name: Session VWAP
session_vwap.comment: Running session VWAP from Close and Volume

session_vwap_std.name: Session VWAP Std
session_vwap_std.comment: Running volume-weighted standard deviation around session_vwap

session_vwap_z.name: Session VWAP Z
session_vwap_z.comment: Close minus session_vwap divided by session_vwap_std

session_vwap_dev_pct.name: Session VWAP Deviation Percent
session_vwap_dev_pct.comment: Close deviation from session_vwap divided by Close, percent

morning_breakout_long.name: Morning Breakout Long
morning_breakout_long.comment: Close minus morning_high divided by morning range
